name: Wrangler (Cloudflare)
summary: Cloudflare gathers non-user-identifying usage telemetry about Wrangler commands. In the source, metrics are enabled by default unless the user, config or environment turns them off.

optOut.instructions: Run npx wrangler telemetry disable, set send_metrics=false in the project's wrangler.toml, or set WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
